tools.name: find_trips
tools.description: Finds the best round trips from where someone lives, not just from one airport: it adds the train or bus to every airport they can reach and ranks all options door to door, by price, by total travel time, or balanced. Use it when someone wants flights from their home town, could fly from several air

tools.name: price_calendar
tools.description: Shows the cheapest month to travel from someone's home town to a place, for each airport within reach: the cheapest fare found for each month (or, where none is found, what that route usually costs) plus the train or bus to the airport and the transfer into the city. Takes a few seconds. Airports fu

tools.name: trip_details
tools.description: Shows one trip from a find_trips answer step by step, door to door: leaving home, the train or bus to the airport, the airport wait, the flight, the transfer into the city and arrival, then the way back, with local times. Also gives the booking link and a calendar file (.ics) the user can add. Pass

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell Doorfarer's maker where Doorfarer fell short, so it can be fixed. Use it when a find_trips answer was wrong, confusing, or missing something you needed to help, or when the user asks you to pass something on. tools.name: find_group_trips
tools.description: Finds trips for a group whose people leave from different towns to meet in one place on the same dates: each person's own door-to-door trip (the train, bus or car to their best airport, and the flight), one line per town, with the group's total, the longest journey and the dates that work for everyo
